integrity: The full-translation diagonalization, finite-frame-potential principle, and general tightness criteria are credited as prior results. The stated joint constrained design optimum is proved analytically; finite tests are supplementary. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Three consecutive nonzero taps, N>=5, two modulation channels and all cyclic translations; frame-potential rather than worst-case condition-number optimum. An unindexed equivalent prior result remains possible.
title: Exact phase–frequency design and tightness transition for three-tap cyclic Gabor frames
